header.title: Command Palette
header.description: Floating command search for moving around the app with the keyboard. It opens with Ctrl+K (⌘K on Mac), filters as you type and runs the chosen command with Enter. Use it to go to pages, launch frequent actions or search long lists without the mouse. It opens as a modal `<dialog>` on top of the page.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Adjust the props, open the palette and see the code instantly. Type to filter, move with the arrows and pick with Enter.

base.title: Basic usage
base.description: Pass `items` and control opening with `open` and `onOpenChange`. By default it listens for Ctrl+K (⌘K on Mac) across the page to open and close; in this example the shortcut is active. Arrows move the highlight, Enter runs the command and Escape closes. `onSelect` receives the `id` of the chosen command.

grouped.title: Grouped commands
grouped.description: With `type: "group"` you group commands under a heading. Groups hide automatically when none of their commands match the search. The filter looks at the label, description, `keywords` and shortcut: try typing "account" to find "Open profile".

async.title: Async search
async.description: To search on a server, control the search with `query` and `onQueryChange`, turn off the built-in filter with `shouldFilter={false}` and show `loading` while results arrive. Keep a request counter to discard stale responses if the user keeps typing.

empty.title: No results
empty.description: `emptyText` is the message when there are no commands or none match the search. It's in English by default, so pass it translated if needed.

disabledDanger.title: Disabled and danger
disabledDanger.description: Commands with `disabled` look dimmed and the keyboard skips them. With `danger` they show in red, for destructive actions like deleting.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: `size` changes the panel width (`sm` 28rem, `md` 36rem and `lg` 42rem) and the inner spacing of the search and commands. On small screens the panel takes the available width.

footer.title: Custom footer
footer.description: By default the footer shows the keys to navigate, select and close, in English. On this page every palette gets it translated; with `footer` you can also show your own tip or pass `null` to hide it.

texts.tip: Tip: type a page name, then press Enter.

router.title: With a router
router.description: Commands with `href` do a full navigation (they reload the page). In a SPA use `onSelect` on each command and call the router. This example uses React Router and actually navigates to other pages of these docs.

header.title: Command Palette API
header.description: API reference for the CommandPalette React component: props, CSS classes, CSS variables, tokens and exported types.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: For examples and usage details, visit the component demos page.

import.title: Import
import.description: You can import it from the main entry or from its subpath. It's also exported under the `Command` alias.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Accepts the HTML attributes of the <dialog> (DialogHTMLAttributes<HTMLDialogElement>), except title, open and onSelect, and passes them to that element. For the search field use inputProps. classNames accepts root, input, list, group, item, empty, footer and shortcut.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.dialog: It opens with showModal() in a <dialog> with aria-modal: the rest of the page becomes inert and scrolling is locked.
a11y.combobox: The search field has role="combobox", aria-controls and aria-activedescendant, so focus stays in the field while the highlight moves.
a11y.listbox: The list has role="listbox" and each command role="option" with aria-selected. While loading it adds aria-busy.
a11y.keyboard: Up and down arrows move the highlight, Home and End jump to the first and last, Enter runs and Escape closes.
a11y.focus: When it opens it focuses the search, and when it closes it returns focus to the previously active element.
a11y.disabled: Commands with disabled get aria-disabled and the keyboard skips them.
a11y.shortcut: The global Ctrl+K / ⌘K shortcut is heard across the page. If several palettes are mounted, keep it active on just one and set shortcut={false} on the rest.
a11y.labels: placeholder, label, emptyText, loadingText and the footer are in English. Pass them translated if your app uses another language.

cssClasses.title: CSS classes
cssClasses.description: Classes you can use to override styles.

rules.search: Search row, with the icon and the field.
rules.item: Each command. Receives `classNames.item`. It's an `<a>` when it has `href`.
rules.body: Container for the label and description.
rules.label: Command label.
rules.kbd: Each key of the shortcut and of the footer hints.
rules.mark: Part of the text that matches the search.
rules.status: Loading or empty message. Receives `classNames.empty` when there are no results.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: The other colors come from tokens, so to change them redefine the tokens in your own class (`.gem-command-palette.my-class`).

items.--gem-command-palette-width: Maximum panel width. Set by the size classes; to change it use your own class with higher specificity.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: gem-system tokens used by Command Palette.

items.--gem-color-bg-subtle: Background of the highlighted command and keys.
items.--gem-color-fg-muted: Icons, descriptions, group headings, messages and footer.
items.--gem-color-primary-500: Highlight of the text that matches the search (at 28%).
items.--gem-radius-{radius}: Panel corners from `radius`. `--gem-radius-sm` is also used on commands and keys.
items.--gem-palette-neutral-{n}: Text, borders and muted colors in the dark theme.

types.title: Exported types
types.description: Available from @gem-org/gem-system to type your own wrappers. Utilities like `defaultCommandFilter` and `highlightCommandMatch` are exported too.

props.title: Props
props.description: Props of the palette and of each entry in `items`.

commandPalette.title: CommandPalette
commandPalette.description: Component props. It also accepts the HTML attributes of the `<dialog>`.

items.defaultOpen: Initial state when you don't control `open`.
items.defaultQuery: Initial search when you don't control `query`.
items.placeholder: Hint text of the search field.
items.label: Accessible name of the dialog and the list.
items.emptyText: Message when there are no results.
items.loading: Shows a loading row instead of the commands.
items.shortcut: Global shortcut to open and close: `true` uses Ctrl/⌘+K, a letter changes the key and `false` turns it off.
items.shouldFilter: Filters commands by the search. Turn it off if you filter yourself, for example on the server.
items.filter: Custom function to decide whether a command matches. By default it looks at label, description, `keywords` and shortcut.
items.closeOnSelect: Closes the palette when a command is chosen.
items.resetOnOpen: Clears the search every time it opens.
items.loop: Reaching the end with the arrows wraps to the start, and vice versa.
items.footer: Footer content. By default shows the help keys; `null` hides it.
items.onOpenChange: Called when opening or closing, also via the shortcut, Escape or backdrop click.
items.onSelect: Called when a command is chosen, with its `id` and the full command.

command.title: Command
command.description: Each entry of `items` (or of a group) that isn't a group.

items.label: Command text.
items.shortcut: Shortcut shown at the end (`"Ctrl+K"` or `["Ctrl", "K"]`). Visual only.
items.href: Turns the command into a link and navigates when chosen.
items.target: Where the `href` opens. With `_blank` it opens a new tab.
items.rel: Link relationship. With `_blank` it defaults to `noopener noreferrer`.
items.disabled: Shows it dimmed and the keyboard skips it.
items.danger: Shows it in red, for destructive actions.
items.keywords: Extra words used by the filter.
items.searchText: Replaces the searched text when `label` isn't plain text.
items.closeOnSelect: Overrides the palette `closeOnSelect` for this command.
items.ariaLabel: Accessible name when `label` isn't plain text.
items.onSelect: Called when this command is chosen.
